_comment: Copy to config/profile.json and fill in. Nothing here is used to fabricate resume content - it drives job matching, tailoring context, and outreach only.
_target_titles_note: The roles you actually want. Keep entries specific - a bare word like 'Manager' matches hundreds of irrelevant postings.
_locations_note: locations = acceptable. location_priority = order to surface them in. Anything not listed is outside preference.
_salary_note: Fill during onboarding. State them only where an employer actually asks - volunteering a number early anchors a negotiation before there is an offer.

outreach._note: Optional. Only used by the pipeline for Gmail drafts. The agent drafts, you send.

messaging._note: Optional. Fill only if you set up the Telegram bot - see docs/01_SETUP_API_KEYS.md.

discovery._note: Optional. Only used by the pipeline.
